title: Hyphenation (Liang patterns) in paragraph layout
objective: Implement TeX hyphenation: Liang pattern matching with the standard US English patterns (hyph-en-us, license-checked and vendored), \hyphenation exceptions, \lefthyphenmin/\righthyphenmin (2/3), discretionary breaks in the Knuth-Plass line breaker with \hyphenpenalty/\exhyphenpenalty, \- and \discretionary. Then the two overfull lines in HW1/HW2 (counterexample, satisfy) must break as pdflatex does.
acceptance: HW1/HW2: 0 overfull_hbox and line breaks identical to the reference PDFs
a 30-paragraph oracle corpus with identical break positions to pdflatex
notes: MacTeX is available on this machine: use it as the oracle (pdflatex word positions / rasters), never in the product path. Report on GitHub issue #2 with SHAs and test counts at every checkpoint; ack with `python3 scripts/coord.py ack`.
